author: EmuCore - Hub
title: PS2 Water Demo
summary: A two-minute PS2 graphics demo shows a rippling pool and flat tree images that turn towards the camera. Mavab presents a university graphics project from 2008.

blocks.text: Mavab’s video begins with the demonstration controls, then shows different views of a small enclosed pool. The camera movement reveals the water surface, brickwork and trees. The creator describes an Abertay university project combining 3D rendering and water simulation. The trees use flat images turned towards the camera, a graphics technique called billboarding. According to the creator, matrix calculations run on the console’s vector units.

The recording shows one focused educational project. It does not provide all the source code or a reproducible performance measurement. Watch how the water and trees change with the viewpoint. The uploaded video’s frame rate does not establish the console’s exact internal timing. The original 2008 publication date is retained because this is an archival demonstration.
